meaning: Premise-free laws comparing the accounts of de re possibility of absence at the foundational case (power-grounded, combinatorial, essentialist in two forms, hybrid) and the Pruss reconstruction, then finite models: a theist nonvacuity model, the Pruss-without-PGP separation, the brute foundational model, the existence-conditional model with four omission models, the primitivist pair, the hybrid First Way model, six Pruss omission models and two one-sided conceivability models.
